name: Bodyweight Squat

instructions.description: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your arms positioned for balance.
Bend at the hips and knees as if sitting back, keeping the whole foot supported.
Descend only as far as control and comfort allow while moving the hands forward to improve balance and stability.
Press through the feet to return to standing while exhaling.

commentsNotes: Use a chair behind you as an optional depth guide.

variations.variationDescription: Goblet Squat meaningfully changes the difficulty, loading, support, or movement demands compared with Bodyweight Squat.
Bodyweight Squat — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Bodyweight Squat — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.
